notes.title: Update Notes for 21/03/2025
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with 'returning to previous level' on the level select/map screen
 Slightly adjusted enemy spawn rate in third encounter of 'The Temple'

notes.title: Update Notes for 10/12/2024
notes.content:
Fixed an error at the start of 'The Defiance'
Added controller support for the Bonus Level

notes.title: Update Notes for 27/11/2024
notes.content:
Fixed Nexus' starting placement on repeat plays of levels/shops
 Adjusted timing in cutscene at the end of 'The Temple'
 Adjusted collision on pedestals in 'The Streets' to block fire
 Fixed blast's explosions so the enemies triggering the explosion aren't hurt by both
 Shrunk level icons for 'The Battlements', 'The Gatehouse', and 'The Throne Room' (and the nearby light shop) for ease of navigation
 Shrunk King Phemus' hitbox to better fit his actual size
Removed ability to get out of bounds in 'The Village'
Adjusted a cutscene trigger in 'The Mountain'

notes.title: Update Notes for 22/11/2024
notes.content:
Added helpful notes to main menu UI
 Fixed a typo in 'The Light Shop' descriptions
 Adjusted camera in 'The Crypt''s final cutscene
 Fixed the healing tutorial's trigger in 'The Crypt'
 Added 1 grave to 'The Temple' to pay tribute to those who have fallen in this level
